description: Delegate an independent task to a subagent that runs in parallel. The brief must be self-contained. Returns a task id; collect the report with await_tasks.
name: spawn_agent

access.description: Set "write" for a subagent that will edit files while other writers run at the same time: it gets a git worktree of its own on its own branch (made from the project's last commit), its file tools and commands work there, and when it finishes its changes are committed on that branch and its report says whether the branch merges cleanly; merge it yourself. Outside a repository it shares your folders. Leave it out for a lone writer that should edit your folders directly, and for subagents that only read (they always share your folders). Default read.

agent.description: The name of a named agent from the list in your instructions: the subagent works under that agent's own instructions, with the tools its file lists (never more than yours), and on its model unless you pass model. The brief is still what it is asked to do.

effort.description: How hard the subagent's model thinks, if it can reason. Default: the session's effort.

knowledge.description: A topic (up to 300 characters) that keeps this read-only subagent as a knowledge agent when its first turn finishes, so you and other subagents can ask it questions with ask_agent instead of reading what it read again. Use it for research whose results several later tasks will need, such as reading a module, a specification or a set of pages; it runs on Emperor when that model is installed. Not for writers or single_call subagents.

location.description: Restrict to models on this machine or at hosted providers

model.description: A model table id (or <endpoint>:<model>) to use

single_call.description: The subagent gets the brief and no tools, answers in exactly one model call, and its reply is the report. Use for hard, self-contained questions; put everything it needs in the brief. Default false.

tags.description: Labels such as code or vision that delegation rules match. Task classes route by default: refactor, tests, ui, format, docs prefer small local models; architecture, math, proof, algorithm, design prefer cloud frontier models.

tier.description: Minimum model capability; the cheapest suitable model is chosen. Default standard.

title.description: A short name for the task, 3 to 6 words, such as "Fix login redirect test"; shown to the user instead of the task id. Derived from the brief when left out.
